(Nasdaq: RAPP) (“Rapport” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery and development of small molecule precision medicines for patients with neurological and psychiatric disorders, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided a business update, including a summary of the recently announced positive topline results from its Phase 2 trial of RAP-219 in adults with acute bipolar mania and updates across the RAP-219 development program and pipeline.
RAP-219 in Bipolar Mania • Positive Phase 2 Topline Results.

On October 20, 2026, the Company reported topline results from its randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial of RAP-219 in adults with bipolar I disorder (BD) (N=253) experiencing an acute manic episode.
